title: /ping returns no response in real Telegram chat (cutover regression)
description: After cutover to telegram-order-bot-260616 (commit bf625ac, deployed version 26ba402e), the new top-level /ping handler is not delivering the /pong response to real Telegram chats. Synthetic curl tests return 200 OK but the actual Telegram user does not see the /pong message. Possible causes being investigated: (1) webhook is pointing to the OLD telegram-order-bot worker instead of the new one, (2) the HTML parse_mode in send() is silently failing on the multi-line response containing env= and quotes, (3) Cloudflare edge caching on POST /webhook, (4) the deployed bundle is missing the /ping change. Plan: simplify /ping response to single-line without HTML-special chars, redeploy, ask user to verify getWebhookInfo URL, then send real /ping.

title: Structured quantity field for orders
description: Add a dedicated quantity column to the orders table instead of parsing it from free-text specs. Benefits: easier sorting/filtering, structured reporting, input validation. Trade-off: more complex parsing for combined specs like '2x size M'.
